info.description: Task Management RESTful API Backend with authentication, organizations, projects, tasks, statuses, and labels management.
info.title: GoTask API

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile based on JWT token.
Get all clients for the current organization.

post.description: Create a new client for the current organization.

get.description: Get total count, total revenue, and average revenue for clients.
Get a single client by ID.

post.description: Sends a password reset email to the user if the email exists.

200.description: If the email exists, a reset link has been sent

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the server process is alive. Used for basic liveness and Docker HEALTHCHECK.

post.description: Accept an organization invitation using the token received via email. The authenticated user must match the invited email.

401.description: User email does not match invitation

410.description: Invitation has expired or been revoked

post.description: Resend an invitation email to the previously invited email address. Extends the expiry time.

delete.description: Revoke an existing invitation token, preventing it from being accepted. Requires owner or admin role.

get.description: Get all invoices for the current organization.

post.description: Create a new invoice with auto-generated invoice number (INV-YYYY-XXX).

get.description: Get a single invoice by ID.

patch.description: Update an invoice. Setting status to "paid" triggers revenue sync to client.

delete.description: Delete a label. The label will be removed from all associated tasks.

patch.description: Update a label's name or color.

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.
Create a new organization. The requesting user automatically becomes the owner.

get.description: Retrieve all pending invitations for the organization. Requires owner or admin role.

post.description: Send an invitation email to add a new member to the organization. Requires owner or admin role.

get.description: Retrieve all members of the organization with their roles.

delete.description: Remove a member from the organization. Requires owner or admin role. Owner cannot be removed.

403.description: Insufficient permission or cannot remove owner

patch.description: Update a member's role within the organization. Requires owner or admin role. Cannot change owner's role.

403.description: Insufficient permission or cannot change owner role

get.description: Retrieve all projects belonging to the current organization.

post.description: Create a new project within the organization.

get.description: Retrieve a single project by ID.

delete.description: Delete a project and all its associated tasks. Requires owner or admin role.

patch.description: Update a project's fields (name, description, status, priority, budget, deadline, progress).

get.description: Retrieve all labels belonging to a specific project.

post.description: Create a new label for categorizing tasks within a project.

get.description: Retrieve all task statuses for a specific project.

post.description: Create a new status (e.g., "To Do", "In Progress", "Done") within a project.

get.description: Retrieve all tasks belonging to a specific project with pagination.
Checks database connectivity. Returns 200 when DB is reachable, 503 when not. Used for load balancer readiness probes.

post.description: Register a new user with email and password. Returns the created user object and JWT token.

400.description: Validation error or email already exists

delete.description: Delete a status. Fails if the status is still in use by any task.

400.description: Failed to delete (status might be in use)

patch.description: Update a status name or position (index). Useful for reordering statuses in a Kanban board.

post.description: Create a new task within a project.

get.description: Full-text search across task titles with optional filters for assignee, status, priority, project, and date ranges.

patch.description: Update a task's fields. Supports optimistic locking via expected_version.

organizations.AcceptInvitationRequest.description: Request body for accepting an organization invitation

organizations.InviteMemberRequest.description: Request body for inviting a member to organization

organizations.ResendInvitationRequest.description: Request body for resending an invitation

organizations.UpdateMemberRoleRequest.description: Request body for updating member role

projects.UpdateProjectRequest.description: Request body for project update (all fields optional)

tasks.CreateLabelRequest.description: Request body for creating a label

tasks.CreateStatusRequest.description: Request body for creating a status

tasks.CreateTaskRequest.description: Request body for creating a task

tasks.UpdateLabelRequest.description: Request body for updating a label

tasks.UpdateStatusRequest.description: Request body for updating a status

tasks.UpdateTaskRequest.description: Request body for updating a task

utils.APIResponse.description: Standard API response envelope used by all endpoints

success.description: True if the request was successful
